concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-eps-android-component]] — 2026-09-15 EPS Android Components Sessions (Checkout API v68+) and Advanced add-on, with Compose/view `EPSComponent` examples, redirect prerequisites and a separate SEPA Direct Debit token path.
warnings: Checkout API v68+ is stated in the Sessions requirements, not the separate Advanced table; do not apply it to Advanced without another source.

The Sessions recurring subsection gives `/payments` token-creation fields rather than spelling out a Sessions-specific token request; ordinary no-extra-fields statements and recurring fields have different scopes.
The optional configuration snippets contain doubled braces and placeholder value, and are not copy-ready Kotlin.
